items.title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Wins First Approved Tokenised Money Market Fund Mandate
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE:JPM) is providing its Kinexys multi chain tokenisation system as the blockchain infrastructure for a new tokenised US dollar money market fund share class launched by Schroders. Schroders is the first global asset manager to receive approval for a tokenised share class in a US dollar money market fund using J.P. Morgan's blockchain platform.
